identification: Treacle/Rockingham-type brown glazed earthenware face jug moulded as Lord Kitchener (moustache, side hair, ears), with a loop handle and paper tag number. Unglazed to a rough-glazed base; no mark, signature or date on the base or under the handle in photos 4 and 6. Could be Launceston (John Campbell) or Bendigo or imported; cannot be told without a mark.
